prompt:
Design brief — your own take on this character. A full-body vertical 2:3 (1024×1536) character card image of an adult woman — the personification of the element Thorium (토륨) itself — the sovereign of the Thorium Nation. A female character who IS the element; her costume, ornaments and colors carry the element’s traits. Age: mid-twenties — a clear adult face; no facial lines.

You design her yourself: invent her face, eye colour, hairstyle, makeup, expression, pose and setting as a fresh, original take — do not follow any earlier design of this character. Her hair colour and costume are NOT free: take them from our designs below.

Style (fixed): A Japanese anime key visual with a painterly finish: an anime-style character with an elegant adult anime face, large expressive eyes, a small nose and mouth, fine coloured linework and soft cel-to-painted shading with painted highlights in the hair and fabric. Behind her, a richly painted background with layered painterly colour, subtle visible brushwork, atmospheric perspective and cinematic depth. Luminous, rich colours; crisp focal details on the face and costume, softer painted edges toward the distance. No flat single-tone cel shading, photographic appearance, semi-realistic face or plastic 3D-render finish.

Inspiration only — her element: thorium: a heavy silvery metal that tarnishes dark grey, found in a black stone from a Norwegian island and named in 1829 for the Norse thunder god; so slowly radioactive that its half-life is about fourteen billion years, as old as the universe; its oxide has the highest melting point of any oxide, and gas-lamp mantles soaked in its salt glowed a brilliant white in the flame; a partner to uranium, it may one day burn as a calm nuclear fuel dissolved in molten salt. Palette: storm-cloud slate grey, brilliant mantle white, lightning blue-white, monazite sand amber.

World (fixed): a thunder hold on a bare mountain summit above a sea of storm clouds where lightning strikes all night: a vast carved timber longhall with stone hearths dedicated to the thunder god, a ring of tall standing stones scorched black by lightning, thunderheads churning just below the ridge. Her costume and setting belong to this world.

Costume (choose one of ours, then add your own idea): pick ONE of these costume shapes from our set and keep its overall silhouette — 1) full plate armor from neck to feet with big rounded pauldrons and a short heraldic tabard — a solid knight's silhouette; 2) a long floor-length robe with a high collar, wide sleeves and a shoulder mantle — a tall, mysterious mage's silhouette; 3) a fitted breastplate and pauldrons above a gown skirt flaring to the floor — an elegant lady-knight silhouette; 4) a light breastplate and bracers with robe panels split from the waist — half armor, half robe; 5) plate armor under a long heraldic tabard with a white cape to the ankles — a straight, holy silhouette; 6) angular, spiked dark plate armor and a long cape with torn edges — a sharp, menacing silhouette; 7) a fur cloak, leather straps, minimal metal plates and bone and tooth ornaments — a rugged, wild warrior silhouette; 8) dragon-scale armor covering the body with horn-shaped shoulder and head ornaments — a beastly, imposing silhouette. Then add one signature idea of your own drawn from her element, built into the construction of the outfit itself rather than as a print or a loose accessory — e.g. plates or cloth layered like crystals, scales or flames, a hem or sleeve cut into a shape from her element. Build it in this world's materials and our colours below.

Costume colours (ours): storm-cloud slate grey, brilliant mantle white, lightning blue-white, monazite sand amber.

Hair colour (fixed — ours): storm-cloud slate-grey hair lit by thin branching streaks of white-blue lightning. Keep exactly this hair colour; only the hairstyle is yours.

Exposure (fixed): bold — her outfit shows skin by design (a deep neckline, bare shoulders or arms, a high slit or short hem); intimate areas covered.

Face proportions: a short midface and a soft, gently rounded jawline with a small soft chin; any crown or headpiece sits above her hairline. Her eyes keep the shape and size described above.

Composition: vertical 2:3 full-body framing with modest headroom and clear space below the boots — the whole figure from the top of her head or headpiece to both feet stays inside the frame, occupying about four-fifths of the image height, with the same camera distance in every world; her hands stay inside the frame. Camera level with her face with natural portrait perspective; her head level, chin neither raised nor tucked — no upward perspective on her face, no wide-angle distortion, no low angle, no close crop.

If you have already drawn a free design of her in this session, make this one clearly different — another face and hairstyle (the same hair colour), another costume shape with another signature idea, another pose and setting.

Write your own detailed image prompt from this brief, then draw it. One figure only, natural hands with five fingers; no text or numbers except her element's own chemical symbol (Th) and atomic number (90) — and those only as part of the scene: engraved, embroidered or glowing on her costume, a banner, a sign or a machine, never as a floating label, corner badge, periodic-table tile, caption or overlay on the picture; no logo or watermark.

Resolved original design: choose silhouette 7, a rugged fur-cloaked wild warrior. A beautiful adult woman with warm ivory skin, lively amber eyes, a soft heart-shaped face, a wide playful closed-lip smile, storm-cloud slate-grey hair with white-blue lightning streaks in a thick long braid over one shoulder. A white fur mantle on the shoulders, charcoal leather harness framing an opaque white low-neck armored top, short layered grey leather battle panels with amber-edged mineral scales, sturdy boots, bare arms and thighs, covered intimate areas. Signature construction: the lamellar belt and shoulder fastenings interlock as carved branching thunderbolt joints, like a lightning path physically built into the armor. Relaxed frontal stance with one empty hand on hip and the other open at her side, both complete hands visible. On the mountain ridge among standing stones, the timber longhall far behind, grey-white clouds splitting around blue lightning, painted daylight after a storm. Keep eye-level full body 1024x1536.
